messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up: autopay for NovoHealth (acct NH-512) failed on INV-2217 ($6,325). Gateway decline: expired_card. Need quick decision: generate single-use link, short grace, or attempt manual retry?

Ethan Wu: here's the gateway response snippet I pulled:
```json
{"status":"failed","error":{"type":"card_error","code":"card_declined","decline_code":"expired_card","message":"Card has expired"},"pm":"pm_9Ab...","customer":"cus_9Vx..."}
```

Nora Kim: I reached out. They said their AP team rotated cards last week and didn't propagate to vendors. They asked for a secure pay link and a 72-hour grace period to update billing. They also asked if we can temporarily enable service while they update.

billing-bot: Autopay policy: next retry in 24h (attempts left: 2). Dunning emails scheduled.

Ethan Wu: Ops proposal: suspend retries & dunning while CS sends link, create single-use hosted payment page (expires 72h), and apply a modest $500 temporary credit hold to keep them from throttling. Manual collect only after link payment. Note: card-on-file updates often require 3DS; if customer uses new corporate card vaulting should succeed.

Maya Patel: Approve $500 temporary credit and 72h extension. Waive automated late fee for this invoice. Pause dunning until payment or expiry of link.

Nora Kim: Customer attempted the link; auth failed with auth_required. They asked if we can accept ACH as fallback. They don't have ACH set up with us yet; that would take 1-2 days. They prefer to retry card once their treasury team returns.

Adyen Connector: Payment session created: sess_4Dk... url https://pay.redwood.com/t/ND44 (single-use, 72h).

Ethan Wu: Finance ok with hosted link only. @billing-bot mark INV-2217 hold=payment_update suppress_dunning=true.

billing-bot: INV-2217 flagged: hold=payment_update; dunning suppressed; autopay retries paused.

Maya Patel: Recap: CS (Nora) continue to coordinate AP and confirm when new card or ACH is ready; Ops (Ethan) created the link and applied $500 temporary credit; Finance approved 72h grace. Keep this open until settled.

Nora Kim: Logged interaction in CRM; customer will try the payment link again this afternoon and may request ACH onboarding. I'll update once settled.

Ethan Wu: Will revert invoice to normal state and clear hold once payment posts.

Maya Patel: Thanks team.
